events.title: Exploring The Sector
events.summary: The starmap will serve as a strategic overview of everything you have discovered while exploring. It will show stargate connections, wormhole connections, trade flow, and more which you can filter if it feels too cluttered. You control what you need to see and how much of it you need to see.Everything you've discovered or explored will be there. events.title: Planetary Expeditions
events.summary: For today's little blog I figured I would show a brief glimpse of gameplay on the planet. You can land on planets, gather supplies, explore, grab loot, interact with the locals. It is intended to heavily expand this feature post launch.You have available to you a rover and your runabout which you land on the planet with while your mothership stays in orbit.Your character will have weapons, tools, scanners, armor, personal shields, throwable shield barriers, grenades etc.

events.title: Modding and Modders
events.summary: When I first began working on the game one of the things I knew I must include was modding. So from the beginning the game has been made modder friendly. Whether you want to modify your own game, create your own universe, your own ships, or create entire campaigns for others that will eventually be possible in some form.The initial release will allow you to completely redesign the entire sector. events.title: Ship classes
events.summary: The player fleet is taking shape around different roles. The current roster includes the Corvette, Assault Frigate, Destroyer, Heavy Cruiser and Battlecruiser. Each brings a different arrangement of weapons, role bonuses, cargo space and handling, giving you reasons to choose a hull beyond its size.The Corvette is the light escort option: a compact ship with fewer weapon mounts and a smaller hold. events.title: Exploration Gameplay
events.summary: Exploration begins with uncertainty. For the most part, if you are friendly with the region’s inhabitants and have not angered them, and you remain in the inner system, you have support. Whether that’s combat, repairs, towing, you have support. But beyond the inner system, navigation becomes blurred and hazardous.
